physical_description.hair_color: Black with natural dark brown undertones

physical_description.complexion: Angular, well-defined facial structure balancing Eastern European sharpness with South Asian softness. High, prominent cheekbones with gentle fullness underneath. Strong, tapered jawline. Clear skin with functional rather than pampered appearance. Minimal facial hair. Warm golden-amber luminosity concentrated on cheekbones, bridge of nose, and upper cheeks, creating visual dimensionality. Cooler undertones along temples, jawline, and forehead creating subtle shadow play.

A single piece of jewelry — a thin braided bracelet in matte gunmetal, possibly containing subcutaneous tech interface. Dressing room aesthetic: function first, invisibility second.
